# weft_image_patch (Resource)

Apply one-time patch operations to cached images (file add/del/mod).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Apply one-time patch operations to cached images. If `images` is omitted,
# the patch fans out to every cached image returned by weft's ListImages RPC.
resource "weft_image_patch" "console" {
  images = [
    "oci://ghcr.io/example/debian:13",
    "oci://ghcr.io/example/ubuntu:24.04",
  ]

  patch {
    add {
      content = <<-EOF
        GRUB_TERMINAL_OUTPUT="console"
        GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="console=tty0 console=hvc0"
      EOF
      dst     = "/etc/default/grub.d/99-console.cfg"
      trigger = "grub-mkconfig"
    }
    del {
      dst = "/etc/motd"
    }
    mod {
      dst = "/etc/ssh/sshd_config"
      old = "^#?PasswordAuthentication.*"
      new = "PasswordAuthentication no"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `images` (List of String) Optional list of image URLs to patch. If omitted, patches are applied to all cached images.
- `patch` (Block, Optional) Patch operations to apply (add/del/mod). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier of the patch run.

<a id="nestedblock--patch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patch`

Optional:

- `add` (Block List) Files to write into the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--add))
- `del` (Block List) Files to remove from the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--del))
- `mod` (Block List) In-place regex substitutions to apply inside files of the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--mod))
